task_instructions: The PERF401 (manual-list-comprehension) and PERF403 fixes transform for-loops into list/dict comprehensions. When the loop iterable is an unparenthesized ternary expression (such as: for value in [values] if isinstance(values, str) else values:), the generated comprehension produces invalid Python syntax, causing ruff check --fix to report 'error: Fix introduced a syntax error'. Update comprehension generation to wrap conditional iterable expressions in parentheses.
expected_behavior: When transforming loops with ternary iterables, the generator must enclose the ternary expression in parentheses: ([values] if isinstance(values, str) else values). The resulting code must be syntactically valid Python.
